Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at the signal on the northbound approach of a Pearland, Texas intersection when the vehicle
behind them, identified as Driver 2, made contact with the rear bumper. Driver 1 reported neck and lower back
discomfort at the scene and stated that a passenger was seated in the rear of the vehicle at the time of impact. The
passenger's exact seating position could not be firmly established from the statements taken, and it remains unclear
whether the reported back strain resulted from this collision or from another cause. Scene photographs confirm the
general point of impact and the position of both vehicles, but no independent witnesses came forward. Some of the
damage visible on the rear of Driver 1's vehicle may pre-date this event, and the extent attributable to this impact has
not been determined. Driver 1 advised that the vehicle had no prior damage known to them. Driver 2 is not listed as a
named driver on the policy covering the vehicle and does not reside with the policyholder. Further review is
recommended before any conclusions are drawn regarding causation or injury.
